nodes.Name: escapeTemplate
nodes.DocComment:
escapeTemplate rewrites the named template, which must be
associated with t, to guarantee that the output of any of the named
templates is properly escaped. If no error is returned, then the named templates have
been modified. Otherwise the named templates have been rendered
unusable.

nodes.Name: evalArgs
nodes.DocComment:
evalArgs formats the list of arguments into a string. It is equivalent to
fmt.Sprint(args...), except that it dereferences all pointers.

nodes.Name: funcMap
nodes.DocComment: funcMap maps command names to functions that render their inputs safe.

nodes.Name: escaper
nodes.DocComment:
escaper collects type inferences about templates and changes needed to make
templates injection safe.

nodes.Name: rangeContext
nodes.DocComment: rangeContext holds information about the current range loop.

nodes.Name: makeEscaper
nodes.DocComment: makeEscaper creates a blank escaper for the given set.

nodes.Name: filterFailsafe
nodes.DocComment:
filterFailsafe is an innocuous word that is emitted in place of unsafe values
by sanitizer functions. It is not a keyword in any programming language,
contains no special characters, is not empty, and when it appears in output
it is distinct enough that a developer can find the source of the problem
via a search engine.

nodes.Name: escape
nodes.DocComment: escape escapes a template node.

nodes.Name: escapeAction
nodes.DocComment: escapeAction escapes an action template node.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: pos < len(n.Pipe.Cmds)-1 || c.state == stateAttr && c.delim == delimSpaceOrTagEnd && ident == "html"

Children.Name: case
Children.RawSource: stateURL, stateCSSDqStr, stateCSSSqStr, stateCSSDqURL, stateCSSSqURL, stateCSSURL

nodes.Name: ensurePipelineContains
nodes.DocComment:
ensurePipelineContains ensures that the pipeline ends with the commands with
the identifiers in s in order. If the pipeline ends with a predefined escaper
(i.e. "html" or "urlquery"), merge it with the identifiers in s.

nodes.Name: predefinedEscapers
nodes.DocComment:
predefinedEscapers contains template predefined escapers that are equivalent
to some contextual escapers. Keep in sync with equivEscapers.

nodes.Name: equivEscapers
nodes.DocComment:
equivEscapers matches contextual escapers to equivalent predefined
template escapers.

nodes.Name: escFnsEq
nodes.DocComment: escFnsEq reports whether the two escaping functions are equivalent.

nodes.Name: normalizeEscFn
nodes.DocComment:
normalizeEscFn(a) is equal to normalizeEscFn(b) for any pair of names of
escaper functions a and b that are equivalent.

nodes.Name: redundantFuncs
nodes.DocComment:
redundantFuncs[a][b] implies that funcMap[b](funcMap[a](x)) == funcMap[a](x)
for all x.

nodes.Name: appendCmd
nodes.DocComment:
appendCmd appends the given command to the end of the command pipeline
unless it is redundant with the last command.

nodes.Name: newIdentCmd
nodes.DocComment: newIdentCmd produces a command containing a single identifier node.

nodes.Name: nudge
nodes.DocComment:
nudge returns the context that would result from following empty string
transitions from the input context.
For example, parsing:

	`<a href=`

will end in context{stateBeforeValue, attrURL}, but parsing one extra rune:

	`<a href=x`

will end in context{stateURL, delimSpaceOrTagEnd, ...}.
There are two transitions that happen when the 'x' is seen:
(1) Transition from a before-value state to a start-of-value state without

	consuming any character.

(2) Consume 'x' and transition past the first value character.
In this case, nudging produces the context after (1) happens.

nodes.Name: join
nodes.DocComment:
join joins the two contexts of a branch template node. The result is an
error context if either of the input contexts are error contexts, or if the
input contexts differ.

nodes.Name: escapeBranch
nodes.DocComment: escapeBranch escapes a branch template node: "if", "range" and "with".

nodes.Name: escapeList
nodes.DocComment: escapeList escapes a list template node.

nodes.Name: escapeListConditionally
nodes.DocComment:
escapeListConditionally escapes a list node but only preserves edits and
inferences in e if the inferences and output context satisfy filter.
It returns the best guess at an output context, and the result of the filter
which is the same as whether e was updated.

nodes.Name: escapeTemplate
nodes.DocComment: escapeTemplate escapes a {{template}} call node.

nodes.Name: escapeTree
nodes.DocComment:
escapeTree escapes the named template starting in the given context as
necessary and returns its output context.

nodes.Name: computeOutCtx
nodes.DocComment:
computeOutCtx takes a template and its start context and computes the output
context while storing any inferences in e.

nodes.Name: escapeTemplateBody
nodes.DocComment:
escapeTemplateBody escapes the given template assuming the given output
context, and returns the best guess at the output context and whether the
assumption was correct.

nodes.Name: delimEnds
nodes.DocComment: delimEnds maps each delim to a string of characters that terminate it.

nodes.Name: escapeText
nodes.DocComment: escapeText escapes a text template node.

nodes.Name: contextAfterText
nodes.DocComment:
contextAfterText starts in context c, consumes some tokens from the front of
s, then returns the context after those tokens and the unprocessed suffix.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: c.state == stateAttr && c.element == elementScript && c.attr == attrScriptType && !isJSType(string(s[:i]))

nodes.Name: editActionNode
nodes.DocComment: editActionNode records a change to an action pipeline for later commit.

nodes.Name: editTemplateNode
nodes.DocComment: editTemplateNode records a change to a {{template}} callee for later commit.

nodes.Name: editTextNode
nodes.DocComment: editTextNode records a change to a text node for later commit.

nodes.Name: commit
nodes.DocComment:
commit applies changes to actions and template calls needed to contextually
autoescape content and adds any derived templates to the set.

nodes.Name: template
nodes.DocComment: template returns the named template given a mangled template name.

nodes.Name: arbitraryTemplate
nodes.DocComment:
arbitraryTemplate returns an arbitrary template from the name space
associated with e and panics if no templates are found.

nodes.Name: HTMLEscape
nodes.DocComment: HTMLEscape writes to w the escaped HTML equivalent of the plain text data b.

nodes.Name: HTMLEscapeString
nodes.DocComment: HTMLEscapeString returns the escaped HTML equivalent of the plain text data s.

nodes.Name: HTMLEscaper
nodes.DocComment:
HTMLEscaper returns the escaped HTML equivalent of the textual
representation of its arguments.

nodes.Name: JSEscape
nodes.DocComment: JSEscape writes to w the escaped JavaScript equivalent of the plain text data b.

nodes.Name: JSEscapeString
nodes.DocComment: JSEscapeString returns the escaped JavaScript equivalent of the plain text data s.

nodes.Name: JSEscaper
nodes.DocComment:
JSEscaper returns the escaped JavaScript equivalent of the textual
representation of its arguments.

nodes.Name: URLQueryEscaper
nodes.DocComment:
URLQueryEscaper returns the escaped value of the textual representation of
its arguments in a form suitable for embedding in a URL query.
